All constructions

Every record, grouped by problem, with links to the record file, its exact certificate and its float check on GitHub. Open a problem to see its 39 values of n.

2,133 selected coordinate constructions are certified exactly; 12 better published entries link to the original constructions and have no coordinates or local certificate. Their certified alternatives remain available in the viewer. The same files are in records/; SUMMARY.csv and SUMMARY_families.csv list the project archive values; external_records.json lists independent sources, and data/records.json holds all selected values and alternatives shown on this site. Download the whole repository.

On this pagePlatonicArchimedeanCatalanPrisms and antiprisms

Certified coordinate constructions and attributed published values, not optimality claims. Generalized packing method by Alejandro Zarzuelo Urdiales, building on Yohei Nakajima's soft-to-rigid cube-packing method. Code, records and certificates: github.com/alejandrozu/platonic-packing.
